pattern (grep -Ei): find my note|my notes? (on|about)|do i have (a )?note|what do i know about|what was (that|the) [a-z ]*(idea|note|thought)|did i (ever )?(write|note|jot|save|mention)|have i (ever )?(written|noted)|second brain|newbrain|new brain|(in|from|check) (my|the) brain
hint (one line, <=600 chars): NewBrain, the user's second brain — query it FIRST for their notes/knowledge/people/ideas. PRIMARY: ~/path/to/newbrain/bin/fts.sh "<keywords>" — decompose the question into content keywords (synonyms, named entities, both-language variants), run 2-3 variants, read top-5; ⚠ WEAK MATCH or no matches ⇒ answer "not in the brain". search.sh = exact-phrase fallback. Bash, works cold, NO equip/relaunch. Knowledge = brain; past agent-session work = your session-memory tool. Map: ~/path/to/newbrain/MAP.md
capture into the NewBrain inbox: ~/path/to/newbrain/bin/capture.sh, then bin/inbox-status.sh to confirm. index.tsv is label truth; NEVER move/rename Finder-visible files. Works cold, no equip.

hint (one line, <=600 chars): finding the user's files: 1) brain index first (~/path/to/newbrain/bin/fts.sh "<keywords>"; search.sh for exact phrases), 2) mdfind "<name>" (Spotlight) for unindexed files, 3) filesystem crawl last. SKIP straight to the location when the user names it explicitly ("last file I downloaded" = ~/Downloads by date).

refresh the brain = RUN `bash ~/path/to/newbrain/bin/refresh.sh manual` now (ingest new files from CANON roots → label → extract → rebuild MOCs → rebuild fts.db, one command, logs to moc/log.md). It can also run nightly (launchd) and auto-fire in background from a discovery hook when fts.db is >26h old — run it, don't remind the user. Works cold, no equip.

Room wikis = an ON-DEMAND synthesis cache per room (NOT pre-compiled for every room). To refresh one: `bash ~/path/to/newbrain/bin/compile-room.sh <room>` (pure-bash GATHER → moc/wiki/<room>/_BUNDLE.md, writes a freshness stamp), then the agent reads the bundle + rewrites OVERVIEW.md + concept pages cluster-wise (small rooms one-shot; big rooms cluster-by-cluster). Staleness auto-surfaces: lint.sh + the SessionStart digest print `⚠ wiki stale: <room>` when a room's notes drift from its stamp — recompile to clear. Compile a NEW room only when synthesis questions about it recur. Never move/rename files; no db rebuild needed.
NewBrain maintenance: bin/inbox-status.sh (unrouted count), bin/lint.sh (ledger health: dead paths/unlabeled), bin/recent.sh (recent captures). All at ~/path/to/newbrain/bin/. Works cold, no equip.
